cohort: 220 pregnant women, 110 with GDM and 110 without GDM, from a low socioeconomic status population in Gaya, Bihar, India
finding: The prevalence of GDM was 4.23%, and adequate treatment with diet, oral hypoglycemic agents, or insulin resulted in near-normal maternal and neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: There was no significant difference in the mode of delivery between the two groups.
birth_weight: Mean birth weight was significantly higher in the GDM group (2887.61g +/- 542.57) compared to the control group (2763.59g +/- 646.12).
